footer.note: We describe what the records show. We do not make accusations. Contractors can send a reply that appears next to any finding.
home.headline: Where did the money go? Did the fix last?

rti.title: RTI application draft
rti.help: Fill in your name and address, pay the ₹10 fee and give it to the ward office. A reply is due within 30 days.
rti.enter: Complaint ID, work order or road ID

rti.appeal: If not satisfied: first appeal under Section 19(1) within 30 days.
rti.lawful: This draft only asks for public documents, for citizen verification.
